milestone.title: Native Rust geometric intelligence — conversation, memory, reasoning and coding
milestone.description:
Build useful local geometric intelligence in Rust: preparation, learning, artifacts and inference. Prime/ordered-n-let addresses, fixed zeta phases, R4/S3/H4 state, exact Z[phi]/orientation, typed paired-H4/icosian geometry and UOR identity remain primary. Offline Rust training may use matrix multiplication; serving uses learned bounded geometric routing/state and integer/table operators, with no hidden dense transformer or response provider.

Immediate owner-adopted sequence (2026-09-05): #1137 role-aware shared source selection/commit -> #1138 learned exact relations beyond the raw window -> #1139 selective geometric access at complete cost -> #1140 learned typed operator composition for conversation and Rust reasoning. #973 is the model parent; #820 is the programme tracker. Only the earliest unmet step is immediate work. An accepted behavioral handoff, not mere issue closure, unlocks the next step.

Canonical plan and responsibility consolidation: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/project-track.md
Actual implementation/artifacts/results: https://github.com/UOR-Foundation/uor-r4/blob/main/docs/integration/current-state.md

After the four accepted handoffs: broader #954 correctness, #955 reasoning, #962 conversation/service, #1088 coding/workspace, #963 optimization, #964 guarantees/publication and #965 integrated qualification/release. Both alpha capability groups remain unqualified. Historical positive, negative and unavailable results retain their exact scope.

One task/agent; budget-friendly complete cycles and cumulative accounting. Necessary storage increases are preauthorized and recorded; no deletion or paid compute. Protected PR delivery remains required. Planning changes do not establish model capability or geometric advantage.

comments.body:
The frozen execution plan is now protected on `main` through PR #987 at `5de08b7e21cdd100a89782f480dc129cef3cd04d`.

The binding contract includes canonical vertex-disjoint matched pairs, audit-only pair metadata, six full harmonic sweeps with equal-work controls, shared label-free induction scales, equal-budget `delta_F`/`delta_T` calibration, and an exact pair-blocked full-versus-table test. This issue remains open and unassigned until execution starts. No mechanism run, corpus build, zeta calculation, #953 generation, or runtime lowering was performed by the planning delivery.

#986 bounded feasibility run contract

metric and current value: pre-sealed prerequisite coverage; the pinned 3,000-document source corpus is content-valid, but zero of the required 48 matched pair records are frozen and zero complete lexical-route O(x) bindings are certified
reachability ceiling: Gate 0 requires 100% population, placement, link, and operator coverage; one missing route operator makes the ceiling 0%, and the live implementation supplies no lexical-route-to-SpiralCore map at all
cheap instrument and binding verdict: the focused graph-certify prerequisite certificate must reproduce the corpus/source facts and derive the frame status from the canonical SpiralCore chart; proceed only if it reports an exact 16-pair calibration population, exact 32-pair test population, and complete same-frame operator coverage
exit threshold: all population and frame prerequisites must be exact before placement, diffusion, labels, calibration, or selection
if positive: bind the immutable pre-geometry checkpoint and continue to label-free Gate 0
if negative: record the pre-sealed unavailable terminal, leave all later stages NOT_RUN, deliver the evidence, and close #986
cost estimate: under one minute on local CPU; no corpus-scale build, teacher/provider access, geometry, or #953 work

## Frozen terminal

`UNAVAILABLE_FRAME_OR_POPULATION`

The pre-sealed feasibility checkpoint stops here. The pinned raw corpus is reproducible at:

- manifest/raw-bytes CID: `blake3:bb5f446ce92df60f7824ed5a1f04ede385386e7a47b9c198ae83a5d0f907bab3`
- declared/reproduced corpus CID: `blake3:194db0eebf2d49823ece01ee935447a0cc9edeaf018454ceea480ce7590132cf`
- population: 3,000 unique documents; D3 assigns 2,404 construction and 596 held-out documents

No source-free corpus-scale canonical codec, exact induction/calibration/sealed split commitment, or frozen pair artifact is present. Consequently, the pair population is unavailable; zero pairs were not evaluated and must not be read as zero eligible pairs.

Independently, the exact 64-state SpiralCore finite operator/table reproduces at control scope, but chart transport remains `NOT_ESTABLISHED`. The repository does not define a complete lexical-route `O(x)` or bind the compiler and query sides to one signed action/frame convention.

Certificate: `blake3:3fff541e4ac37193babaacd25227019fb401950ccdd936ab38ac46c6c2916337`

Therefore placement, link construction, diffusion, Gate 0, calibration, sealed labels, full/table/control arms, paired comparisons, coverage/work accounting, payload replay, and all #953 implementation or data work are `NOT_RUN`.

Delivery: #988. No successor issue was created. The next admissible work category is a fresh source-free corpus population and complete signed lexical operator/frame commitment; #953 remains parked and ineligible until such evidence exists.
